QT 01.title: Survey of Quantum technologies and Applications
QT 01.group_text: QT 01 and QT 02 are both Mandatory

topics.text: A qualitative overview of salient aspects of quantum physics (4-5 lectures)

children.text: Physical observables, Hermitian operators, expectation values
Heuristic description of Superposition, Tunnelling and entanglement
Simulating classical systems - Feynman's idea of a quantum simulator and the birth of the field
Basics of qubits -- what is a qubit?
How is it different from a classical bit? - Review of classical logic gates
Di Vincenzo criteria for realising qubits
Basics of qubit gates and quantum circuits
Physical implementation of qubits (very qualitative description)
Superconducting Qubits - charge, flux and phase
Overview of applications and recent achievements
Long term goals and strategies being followed
Basics of Photon (single and entangled) generation and detection
State of the art in Quantum Sensing
Basic ideas of quantum communication, security, eavesdropping

topics.text: Topics on Quantum Materials are to be covered in the other portions of the course wherever required and are not listed separately here.

outcomes: The general physical principles of realising qubits for computation
The various hardware implementations of qubits for computation
The basic ideas of quantum sensing
The applications of quantum sensing
The implementations of quantum communications protocols in fibre-based and free-space

QT 01.description: This course is meant to give an overview of the field of quantum technologies and make the students familiar with the state-of-the-art in all four verticals. The emphasis is not on depth in this course, but on covering the exciting aspects of the field.
QT 01.status_sentence: QT 01 is mandatory for every student (together with QT 02).
